definitions.explanation: A theatrical performance or its script.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧どもたちが{劇|げき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧をしている。
examples.english: The children are rehearsing a play.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{劇|げき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じた→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
examples.english: We performed a play at the school culture festival.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {劇|げき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to watch a play
- {劇|げき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧: to perform a play

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{悲劇|ひげき}→悲劇：03577_higeki⟧: tragedy
- ⟦{喜劇|きげき}→喜劇：11835_kigeki⟧: comedy
- ⟦{歌劇|かげき}→歌劇：13234_kageki⟧: opera
- ⟦{演劇|えんげき}→演劇：04106_engeki⟧: theater, drama (as an art or activity)
- ⟦{劇団|げきだん}→劇団：20045_gekidan⟧: theater company
- ⟦{劇場|げきじょう}→劇場：02714_gekijou⟧: theater (venue)
- ⟦{歴史劇|れきしげき}→歴史劇：27951_rekishigeki⟧: historical drama (〜{劇|げき} names a dramatic genre)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧: the everyday word for a play; it also means an act or pretense (⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧をする, to put on an act), which {劇|げき} does not
- ⟦{演劇|えんげき}→演劇：04106_engeki⟧: theater as an art form or activity ({演劇部|えんげきぶ}, drama club), rather than one particular play
